pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, blurred edge gradients; shapes range from quadrilaterals to complex polygons with low angularity due to pixel-level diffusion.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous interconnected network of light-toned pathways; junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial with significant pixel thickness relative to patch size.
